Definition: a (female) assembler (i.e. lecturer); abstractly, preaching (used as a 'nom de plume', Koheleth)
BiblicalUsage: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem — and his word is vanity of vanities, all is vanity. The word is the assembler, the one who gathers the people to hear, and it becomes his name.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Preacher's first words are the whole book in a sentence, and vanity is the verdict on life without God.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
